title: Minimum Window with K Distinct Elements
statement:
Given an array of integers and an integer K, find the length of the smallest contiguous subarray that contains exactly K distinct values.

If no such subarray exists, print -1.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the length of the smallest subarray with exactly K distinct elements, or -1.

examples.explanation: The subarray [1,2] or [2,1] has exactly 2 distinct elements and length 2.
The subarray [2,1,3] or [1,3,4] has 3 distinct elements and length 3.
